name: @insler/platform-integration
description: Private cross-package integration suite for the platform subsystem: exercises the published surface (the three-entrypoint @insler/platform umbrella — fleet scanning, artifact generation, plan/diff reconciliation — plus the @insler/cli sibling's programmatic command API) exactly as an external consumer would, against built dist output. platform is the deployment-intent compiler — static analysis of defineService declarations, pure deterministic codegen, and an in-process plan/diff engine behind the StateProvider seam — so the suite needs no real infrastructure; its only real inputs are declaration fixture files inside the package. Run by the path-filtered Platform Integration workflow; never published to npm.
